subject: Welcome to Zutopia
body: Welcome to Zutopia, somewhere deep in the Scarborough Bluffs... or hills? Or ghetto? We don't know at this point.
All the classics you know and love dearly, that are unforgettable to even those who sometimes roasted them. Anyways, this world is your oyster. Here's the lay of the land:
Home Street is your block: your house, this mailbox, Ms. Pumpkin's office (your landlord, a guinea pig, very serious about rent) and the Museum, which is closed for renovation.
Walk west off Home Street to the Matcha Farm. Walk through the rows to pick ripe leaves, and shoo off the fat squirrels (E). The café needs those leaves.

Walk east to Kensington & Koreatown. Zuzu's Matchacha is the only job in town that pays pickles, so pick up shifts. The MMA Gym and Seoul Food KBBQ are on the same strip, and so is Don Hills Mall: Bombaclat's Home Goods, Hazel's Threads, Parmeet's Anime Den, Ramy's Salon and Shooters Drug Mart (it's called Shooters cuz it's Scarborough, yk), with The Well in the corner.
Keep going east to Kings Park for gymnastics on the lawn, the basketball court, two stray cats who expect pets, and a lake you can wade into if you don't mind getting soaked.
At home, your computer has a typing test and mental math, your bookshelf has your books, and the wardrobe has your clothes.
Controls: WASD or the arrow keys to walk, E or Space to talk and use things, Esc to back out, I for your bag, F to decorate at home, and M to mute the music.
Try the café, the gym and the gymnastics lawn, save up a few pickles, then go see Ms. Pumpkin. She's planning something.
Bookmark this website, because this world is something you will get addicted to more than making random weird noises.
Like Shakira said, Try Everything. Have fun!
